lines.text: On the first day of the seventh month, Ezra read the Law aloud in the square before the Water Gate from daybreak until noon.
Ezra stood on a high wooden platform, and when he opened the book, all the people sat down.
The Levites instructed the people in the Law, explaining it so the people could understand what was being read.
Nehemiah told the weeping people to eat and drink, saying the joy of the LORD was their strength, so they rejoiced.
The people made booths from branches, and Israel had not celebrated like this since the days of King David.
